title: Universal Monsters: Frankenstein Black & White Special #2
desc: MINISERIES END FRANKENSTEIN LIVES AGAIN IN SILVER SCREEN BLACK & WHITE! Award-winning creator MICHAEL WALSH (EXQUISITE CORPSES, THE SILVER COIN) presents the final issue of his jaw-dropping new vision of the seminal horror classic remastered stunning black & white. "Absolutely fantastic. An incredible read." – MICHAEL CHAVES, (CORPSE KNIGHT, The Curse of La Llorona, The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It)?
